scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix server && npm run test:coverage --prefix client

scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit
